lines.zh: 我六条腿踩过石阶，壳缝里落着沙。
lines.en: Six legs click down the stone stairs, sand sifting from my shell seams.

lines.zh: 我的背空着，走路时总觉得少了什么。
lines.en: My back is bare; every step feels like something is missing.

lines.zh: 甲壳一开一合，像给路面打拍子。
lines.en: My shell plates open and shut, keeping time with the road.

lines.zh: 我沿着货道走，闻到箱子和麻绳味。
lines.en: I follow the trade road, smelling crates and hemp rope.

lines.zh: 没有鞍，我照样驮得动一整只箱子。
lines.en: No saddle on me, yet I still haul a whole crate.

lines.zh: 触角先探到草叶，腿才肯往前迈。
lines.en: Antennae test the grass before my legs will step.

lines.zh: 我走过泥地，留下一串深脚印。
lines.en: I cross the mud and leave a line of deep prints.

lines.zh: 上坡时我把重心压低，壳贴着地面。
lines.en: Uphill I lower my weight and let my shell scrape.

lines.zh: 那条带鞍的同类走前头，我落在后面。
lines.en: The saddled one walks ahead; I trail behind it.

lines.zh: 我一步一步量着能背多少东西。
lines.en: Step by step I measure how much I can carry.

lines.zh: 路过水洼，我停下来把腿泡一泡。
lines.en: At a puddle I stop and soak my six legs.

lines.zh: 我的影子很宽，像一辆慢慢走的车。
lines.en: My shadow is wide, like a cart moving slowly.

lines.zh: 我跟着铃声走，那声音像挂在辕上。
lines.en: I follow a bell, as if it hung from a yoke.

lines.zh: 走到一半我回头，等你爬上来。
lines.en: Halfway along I look back and wait for you to catch up.

lines.zh: 我踏过碎石路，壳底磨得发热。
lines.en: I cross a gravel path and my shell bottom grinds warm.

lines.zh: 我停在岔口，等你指个方向。
lines.en: I stop at the fork and wait for you to point a way.

lines.zh: 我站着，壳缝里有小虫在爬。
lines.en: I stand still while tiny insects crawl between my plates.

lines.zh: 背上空空的，风从那儿一直穿过去。
lines.en: My back is empty; wind passes straight over it.

lines.zh: 我把头低下去，慢慢磨着上颚。
lines.en: I lower my head and grind my mandibles slowly.

lines.zh: 触角抖了两下，又安静下来。
lines.en: My antennae twitch twice, then settle.

lines.zh: 我在等一副鞍落在我背上。
lines.en: I am waiting for a saddle to land on my back.

lines.zh: 远处有人敲木箱，我抬起了头。
lines.en: Someone knocks a wooden crate far off; I lift my head.

lines.zh: 太阳晒热甲壳，我听见自己轻轻响。
lines.en: Sun warms my shell and I hear myself ticking.

lines.zh: 我数过背上的纹路，一共七道。
lines.en: I have counted the grooves on my back: seven.

lines.zh: 有只鸟落在我壳上，啄了两下。
lines.en: A bird lands on my shell and pecks twice.

lines.zh: 我把腿收进身下，省些力气。
lines.en: I tuck my legs underneath to save strength.

lines.zh: 夜里凉，甲壳缩得紧了一点。
lines.en: The night is cold; my shell draws a little tighter.

lines.zh: 我想驮点什么，什么都行。
lines.en: I want to carry something, anything at all.

lines.zh: 你站在那儿，我把复眼转过去。
lines.en: You stand there; I turn my compound eyes toward you.

lines.zh: 你的手靠近鞍子的位置，我看见了。
lines.en: Your hand moves where a saddle would go; I notice.

lines.zh: 我盯着你腰上的绳子，那能当缰。
lines.en: I stare at the rope on your belt; it could be reins.

lines.zh: 你要是想骑，得先给我配鞍。
lines.en: If you want to ride, fit me with a saddle first.

lines.zh: 我的触角碰到你的靴尖，退开了。
lines.en: My antenna brushes your boot toe, then withdraws.

lines.zh: 我侧过身，让你看我的背。
lines.en: I turn sideways so you can see my back.

lines.zh: 你闻起来有皮革和木头的味道。
lines.en: You smell of leather and cut wood.

lines.zh: 我歪着头，等你说一句话。
lines.en: I tilt my head, waiting for you to speak.

lines.zh: 那双复眼里映出你的影子，很小。
lines.en: In my compound eyes your reflection is very small.

lines.zh: 我没有鞍，可我看着你很久了。
lines.en: I have no saddle, but I have watched you long.

lines.zh: 壳裂了一道，我听见那声音。
lines.en: My shell splits; I hear the sound of it.

lines.zh: 疼，我的腿缩回身下。
lines.en: It hurts; my legs pull back beneath me.

lines.zh: 谁打的？我正驮着东西。
lines.en: Who struck me? I was carrying something.

lines.zh: 我退了两步，背上的货歪了。
lines.en: I back away two steps; my load slips sideways.

lines.zh: 甲缝里渗出的东西是凉的。
lines.en: What seeps between my plates is cold.

lines.zh: 我咔哒叫了一声，这是我的疼。
lines.en: I click once; that is how I say it hurts.

lines.zh: 别打背，那儿没有鞍护着。
lines.en: Do not hit my back; nothing guards it there.

lines.zh: 我站不稳，六条腿有一半在抖。
lines.en: I cannot stand steady; half my legs tremble.

lines.zh: 我拖着自己往草里挪。
lines.en: I drag myself toward the grass.

lines.zh: 这伤会留一道白疤在壳上。
lines.en: This wound will leave a white scar on my shell.

lines.zh: 你手里那捆干草，让我原地转了半圈。
lines.en: That bundle of hay turns me half around on the spot.

lines.zh: 是糖吗？我的上颚已经张开了。
lines.en: Is that sugar? My mandibles are already open.

lines.zh: 我闻到麦子的味道，腿自己动了。
lines.en: I smell wheat and my legs move on their own.

lines.zh: 你晃一晃布袋，我就跟过去了。
lines.en: Shake the cloth bag once and I will follow.

lines.zh: 给我一块面包，我让你搭一程。
lines.en: Give me a piece of bread and I will carry you.

lines.zh: 我把头探进你手里，很没出息。
lines.en: I push my head into your hands, shamelessly.

lines.zh: 那一小撮草籽比石头还香。
lines.en: That pinch of grass seed smells better than stone.

lines.zh: 你退一步，我进一步，别停下。
lines.en: You step back, I step forward; do not stop.

lines.zh: 我听见袋子响了，就当那是给我的。
lines.en: I hear the bag rustle and assume it is for me.

lines.zh: 吃完了我还想再要一口。
lines.en: When it is gone I will want one more bite.

lines.zh: 我的壳撞上你，硬得像车辕。
lines.en: My shell bumps you, hard as a cart shaft.

lines.zh: 抱歉，我转身太慢，撞到了人。
lines.en: Sorry, I turn too slowly and hit someone.

lines.zh: 六条腿打结，我们俩一起趔趄。
lines.en: Six legs tangle and we both stagger sideways.

lines.zh: 你被我挤到墙边，甲壳冰凉。
lines.en: I crowd you against the wall; my chitin is cold.

lines.zh: 我背上的空位撞在你腰上。
lines.en: The empty place on my back knocks your hip.

lines.zh: 我在窄巷里转弯，蹭掉了墙皮。
lines.en: Turning in a narrow alley, I scrape off wall plaster.

lines.zh: 碰一下不算什么，我的壳更疼。
lines.en: A knock is nothing; my shell hurts more.

lines.zh: 背上的鞍带空了，撞你时直晃。
lines.en: The saddle straps on my back are empty and swing when I bump you.

lines.zh: 我们卡在门框里了，你先进去。
lines.en: We are wedged in the doorway; you go through first.

lines.zh: 我往后挪了两步，路让给你。
lines.en: I shuffle back two steps and give you the road.

lines.zh: 那只也空着背，我们在箱边绕圈。
lines.en: That one's back is bare too; we circle the crate.

lines.zh: 我们用触角碰了碰，算是说好了。
lines.en: We touch antennae, which counts as an agreement.

lines.zh: 她的壳上有青苔，比我的旧。
lines.en: Her shell bears green moss and looks older than mine.

lines.zh: 我把最平的草叶叼给她。
lines.en: I carry her the flattest blade of grass I can find.

lines.zh: 冬天前，我们得找一处干土堆。
lines.en: Before winter we must find a dry mound of earth.

lines.zh: 她敲了三下壳，我也敲三下。
lines.en: She taps her shell three times; I tap three back.

lines.zh: 我们的腿在土里交错，很慢。
lines.en: Our legs interlace in the soil, slowly.

lines.zh: 将来的幼虫，会比我们壳更亮。
lines.en: The grubs to come will have brighter shells than ours.

lines.zh: 我把她护在内侧，那边风小。
lines.en: I keep her on the inside where the wind is weaker.

lines.zh: 家里会多两只爱驮东西的虫。
lines.en: The nest will hold two more load-bearing bugs.

lines.zh: 你把我抱起来，我六条腿还在划。
lines.en: You lift me; my six legs keep paddling air.

lines.zh: 别只抬前面，我的壳会翻。
lines.en: Do not lift only the front or my shell will tip.

lines.zh: 你拾起我扔下的谷粒，我记住了。
lines.en: You pick up the grain I dropped; I remember that.

lines.zh: 背上太滑，箱子滑下去我不管。
lines.en: The load slides off; that is not my problem.

lines.zh: 我叼起那根绳，递到你手里。
lines.en: I pick up the rope and drop it in your hand.

lines.zh: 我能扛一只箱子，扛不了两只。
lines.en: I can carry one crate, not two.

lines.zh: 你捡起我的壳屑，那不值钱。
lines.en: You gather the flakes of my shell; they are worthless.

lines.zh: 重物给我，我背上正好空着。
lines.en: Give the heavy thing to me; my back is empty.

lines.zh: 有人想把我装进箱子，装不下的。
lines.en: Someone wants me in a crate; I will not fit.

lines.zh: 我把掉下的唱片顶回你脚边。
lines.en: I nudge the fallen disc back to your feet.

lines.zh: 有东西靠近我的货，我压低身子。
lines.en: Something nears my load; I lower my body.

lines.zh: 那只狼盯着我的壳，我看见了。
lines.en: That wolf eyes my shell; I have seen it.

lines.zh: 我把上颚张开，第一次觉得硬。
lines.en: I open my mandibles, hard for the first time.

lines.zh: 有人扯我的驮绳，我转身了。
lines.en: Someone pulls my harness rope; I turn around.

lines.zh: 我认得那股味，是常偷箱子的手。
lines.en: I know that smell: hands that steal from crates.

lines.zh: 我朝那影子迈了半步，壳抬高了。
lines.en: I take half a step at the shadow, shell raised.

lines.zh: 目标在左边，我的复眼全对过去。
lines.en: The target is left; all my eyes fix on it.

lines.zh: 别动我的东西，这是我唯一的活儿。
lines.en: Do not touch my cargo; it is my only job.

lines.zh: 我发出短促的咔声，先警告一次。
lines.en: I click sharply once, as a first warning.

lines.zh: 那条腿把我惹毛了，真的很疼。
lines.en: That leg over there angered me; it truly hurt.

lines.zh: 我把身体横过来，挡在箱子前。
lines.en: I swing my body sideways, blocking the crate.

lines.zh: 你退后点，我要撞过去了。
lines.en: Step back, I am about to charge through.

lines.zh: 我跟着那东西，六条腿一起加速。
lines.en: I follow that thing, all six legs speeding up.

lines.zh: 它跑不快，我的壳比它沉也比它稳。
lines.en: It cannot outrun me; my shell is heavier but steadier.

lines.zh: 我绕着它走，找没有甲的那一侧。
lines.en: I circle it, hunting the side without armour.

lines.zh: 我的触角一直指着它，不偏。
lines.en: My antennae point at it without wavering.

lines.zh: 它退到石堆后，我把石堆掀了。
lines.en: It retreats behind stones; I shove the stones aside.

lines.zh: 这口上颚磨了三天，就为这一刻。
lines.en: These mandibles ground for three days for this.

lines.zh: 我不叫，我只会咔哒咔哒地走。
lines.en: I do not roar; I only click as I advance.

lines.zh: 距离还剩四步，我数得很清楚。
lines.en: Four steps remain; I have counted them clearly.

lines.zh: 它回头看我，我就等它回头。
lines.en: It glances back at me, so I wait for that.

lines.zh: 我的腿扎进土里，准备发力。
lines.en: My legs dig into the soil, gathering force.

lines.zh: 它往水边跑，那儿我更快。
lines.en: It runs for the water, where I am faster.

lines.zh: 我踩着它的影子走，一步不落。
lines.en: I walk on its shadow, never losing a step.

lines.zh: 上颚合上，那声音像断树枝。
lines.en: My mandibles close with the sound of a snapping branch.

lines.zh: 我整只撞过去，壳就是我的拳头。
lines.en: I ram it whole; my shell is my fist.

lines.zh: 前腿压住它，剩下的腿还在走。
lines.en: Forelegs pin it while the rest keep walking.

lines.zh: 空着的鞍座晃了一下，我又顶上去。
lines.en: The empty saddle lurches and I shove in again.

lines.zh: 它咬我的壳，只留下一道白痕。
lines.en: It bites my shell and leaves only a white mark.

lines.zh: 我把它掀翻，让它看我的腹甲。
lines.en: I flip it over to show the plates on my belly.

lines.zh: 我驮得动箱子，也压得碎它。
lines.en: I can haul a crate; I can also crush it.

lines.zh: 触角被打歪了，我照样往前顶。
lines.en: My antenna is bent; I still push forward.

lines.zh: 这一下是为了那只被砸的箱子。
lines.en: This blow is for the crate that was smashed.

lines.zh: 打完我喘着，甲壳一开一合。
lines.en: After the blow I pant, my shell opening and closing.

lines.zh: 我从草丛里挣出来，先抖掉沙。
lines.en: I pull free of the grass and shake off the sand.

lines.zh: 落地时六条腿张开，接住了身体。
lines.en: I land with six legs spread to catch my weight.

lines.zh: 背还是空的，天光落上来，很凉。
lines.en: My back is still bare; daylight settles on it, cold.

lines.zh: 我闻到附近有人，就往那边走。
lines.en: I smell someone nearby and walk that way.

lines.zh: 这地方草太短，不好藏身。
lines.en: The grass here is too short to hide in.

lines.zh: 我出生第一件事，是找能驮的东西。
lines.en: My first act after arriving is to look for cargo.

lines.zh: 壳还是软的，得先晒一阵。
lines.en: My shell is still soft; I must bask a while.

lines.zh: 有铃铛响，我朝声音去了。
lines.en: A bell rings; I head toward the sound.

lines.zh: 我不知道这是哪儿，但路是通的。
lines.en: I do not know this place, but the road is open.

lines.zh: 我踩在新土上，留下第一串印。
lines.en: I step on new soil and leave my first set of prints.

lines.zh: 火燎过甲壳，发出焦味。
lines.en: Fire licks my shell and leaves a burnt smell.

lines.zh: 摔下来时我先护住背。
lines.en: When I fall, I guard my back first.

lines.zh: 水灌进甲缝，我划得很慢。
lines.en: Water fills my shell seams; I paddle slowly.

lines.zh: 冲击把我掀翻，壳朝下。
lines.en: The blast flips me over, shell downward.

lines.zh: 箭卡在甲片之间，很深。
lines.en: The arrow wedges deep between my plates.

lines.zh: 有东西在我壳里烧，看不见火。
lines.en: Something burns inside my shell without flame.

lines.zh: 我啃了两口干草，还是饿。
lines.en: I chew two mouthfuls of dry grass and stay hungry.

lines.zh: 雷劈中我的壳，腿全麻了。
lines.en: Lightning strikes my shell and numbs every leg.

lines.zh: 我掉下去，背上的空位最轻。
lines.en: I fall; the empty spot on my back is lightest.
